<strong>Correlación no es causa, y el ex: Correlation is not causation, and the exam asks about it. If two variables rise together, think first of a third one moving both. Saying so explicitly is what gets marked.
<strong>Dibuja la campana y sombrea.</st: Draw the bell and shade it. Before looking in the table, mark on the normal curve the region being asked for. That is what decides whether to subtract from one, add two tails or look up the symmetric value.
<strong>Escribe los sucesos con nombre a: Write the events out with names before calculating. “$A$: the part is faulty”, “$B$: it comes from machine 2”. With the names in place, the tree and Bayes' formula come out by themselves; without them $P(A|B)$ gets confused with $P(B|A)$, which is the classic mistake.
<strong>Un contraste no demuestra la hip: A test does not prove the null hypothesis. It is rejected or not rejected, and not rejecting is not accepting. Nearly all the marks in those questions are in wording the conclusion properly.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each section contributes a fixed number of questions, drawn at random from its topics without repeating a topic while that is possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. With 12 topics and 10 questions, a single exam does not touch them all: that is why the link at the end reproduces the same exam, and “another exam” draws a different one.
Calcular una probabilidad binomial y su: Computing a binomial probability and its mean and variance; standardising and using the normal table; approximating a binomial by a normal when appropriate; the density function and its integral.
Con $p$ por encima del nivel, los datos: With $p$ above the level, the data are compatible with the null. That does not prove it: it only says this sample is not enough to rule it out.
Cómo sacarle partido: How to get the most out of it
Doce temas para lo que no se sabe con ce: Twelve topics for what is not known for certain: describing data, measuring chance and deciding from a sample. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, and with the trap peculiar to statistics: almost every mistake is one of interpretation, not of arithmetic.
El contraste de hipótesis nació como un: Hypothesis testing was born as a quality-control procedure: at the Guinness brewery in Dublin, at the start of the twentieth century, William Gosset needed to decide from very small samples whether one batch of barley was better than another, and he published his distribution under the pen name “Student” because the company forbade publishing. That problem —deciding from few data with a criterion fixed in advance— is exactly the one in the last section of this exam.
El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.
El nivel se fija antes de mirar los dato: The level is fixed before looking at the data, precisely so as not to decide by closeness. Moving it afterwards is what turns a test into a prophecy.
Elegir entre variación, permutación y co: Choosing between arrangements, permutations and combinations; Laplace and the algebra of events; conditional probability, tree diagrams, the law of total probability and Bayes.
Elige los tramos que entran. Las pregunt: Choose the sections to include. The questions are drawn at random from the exercises of each topic in the block, avoiding the most basic ones and without repeating a topic while possible. There are no hints: the marking and the step-by-step solution come on submitting.
Intervalo de confianza para la media y p: A confidence interval for the mean and for a proportion; the sample size for a given error; setting up the hypotheses of a test, deciding, and saying what the result means; telling correlation from causation.
Media, mediana y desviación típica a par: Mean, median and standard deviation from a table; deciding which best summarises data with extreme values; the regression line, the correlation coefficient and what may be predicted with it.
No se rechaza la hipótesis nula: no hay: The null hypothesis is not rejected: there is not enough evidence against it
Se acepta la hipótesis nula: queda demos: The null hypothesis is accepted: it is proved
Se rechaza, porque $0{,}08$ está cerca d: It is rejected, because $0.08$ is close to $0.05$
Un contraste da $p = 0{,}08$ con nivel d: A test gives $p = 0.08$ with a significance level of $0.05$. What is the conclusion?
Un contraste nunca demuestra la nula. Co: A test never proves the null. With a larger sample, that same effect might come out significant: absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 12 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
